scope: Main task only; jobs, model artifacts, and prior run reports excluded

findings.what_is_wrong: Ignored local SQLite, WAL, SHM, and Python bytecode files remain in the working directory from local checks.
findings.impact: They are not tracked by Git, the solution reset removes runtime databases, and artifact collection excludes database files, so they do not affect grading. A manually created archive that ignores Git rules could still include them.
findings.fix: Build delivery archives from tracked files or remove ignored runtime artifacts before manual zipping.

resolved_during_qc.issue: Shift+Click range extension was graded but not stated explicitly.
resolved_during_qc.resolution: Added concise mouse-drag and Shift+Click wording to spreadsheet.md.

resolved_during_qc.issue: Autocomplete used oracle-shaped 1-12 pixel geometry thresholds.
resolved_during_qc.resolution: Removed the standalone geometry criterion and merged semantic below-cell autocomplete into the formula mouse-range workflow.

resolved_during_qc.issue: Stale conflict required exact HTTP 409 although the specification only required rejection.
resolved_during_qc.resolution: Changed it to a semantic 4xx, never 5xx, conflict rejection with state-integrity checks.

resolved_during_qc.issue: Removing the easy live-update verifier left clean-view updates and exact presence counts only implicit.
resolved_during_qc.resolution: Merged clean-view propagation into the two-tab conflict workflow and exact view counts into the remote-selection workflow.

resolved_during_qc.issue: Formula scoring concentration exceeded the preferred review threshold.
resolved_during_qc.resolution: Kept formula weight at 12.5 and raised the confirmed non-formula Shift+Click range criterion to 2.0, reducing formula share to 44.64%.
